mapper.sql: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM organization_access.tenant_membership_role_binding fixed_role WHERE fixed_role.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND fixed_role.membership_id = membership.membership_id AND fixed_role.role_code = membership.membership_role) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM organization_access.tenant_membership_role_binding unexpected_role WHERE unexpected_role.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND unexpected_role.membership_id = membership.membership_id AND unexpected_role.role_code <> membership.membership_role)
mapper.select: SELECT membership.membership_id, membership.subject_id, identity.login_name, membership.membership_role, membership.status, identity.status AS identity_status, identity.version AS identity_version, membership.version, membership.permission_version, membership.created_at, (NOT membership.member_access_pending_revocation AND ) AS access_ready, features.assistant_selection, features.conversation, features.own_history, features.authorized_citations, features.version AS feature_version, (membership.membership_role = 'TENANT_USER' AND AND (SELECT count(*) FROM organization_access.tenant_membership scope WHERE scope.subject_id = membership.subject_id) = 1 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM organization_access.platform_role_binding platform WHERE platform.subject_id = membership.subject_id)) AS password_reset_eligible FROM organization_access.tenant_membership membership JOIN organization_access.tenant_lifecycle lifecycle ON lifecycle.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND lifecycle.status = 'ACTIVE' JOIN organization_access.subject_identity identity ON identity.subject_id = membership.subject_id LEFT JOIN organization_access.member_conversation_features features ON features.tenant_id = membership.tenant_id AND features.membership_id = membership.membership_id WHERE membership.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND membership.membership_id = #{membershipId}
SELECT assistant_id FROM organization_access.member_assistant_authorization WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND membership_id = #{membershipId} ORDER BY assistant_id
